ser.rubrik: I see someone who needs help
ser.intro: Three questions. The answers point you the right way. The phone numbers can be selected and copied.

steg1.fraga: 1. Is the person's life in danger?
steg1.hjalp: For example: does not respond when you call out and gently shake their shoulder, is not breathing normally, is injured, is very cold and confused, or has taken something and is acutely unwell.
steg1.ja: Call 112 right away. Stay until help arrives. If the person is unconscious but breathing: place them in the recovery position and keep them warm.

steg2.fraga: 2. Is it cold outside and the person has nowhere to sleep tonight?
steg2.ja: Call the social emergency service (socialjouren). They can arrange a place for the night or send outreach workers. Say where the person is and what they look like.

steg3.text: Ask. A simple "Hi, do you need anything?" is enough. Respect a no.

lista: Offer something concrete: a hot drink, something to eat, a pair of socks.
Show this page and tell them about the nearest place that is open now.
Buy the magazine Situation Stockholm from a vendor with an ID badge.
Give money if you want to. How it is used is the person's own business.
Do not take photos. Do not push. A conversation is often worth more than you think.

hjalpa.intro: What helps most is often the least visible: money to those already doing the work.

pengar.text: The organisations below run shelters, meals and clinics in Stockholm. The details are taken from their own websites.

saker.text: Always ask the organisation first what they need right now. Often requested:
behovs: Warm winter clothes in good condition, especially large sizes
Toiletries: toothbrush, toothpaste, deodorant, sanitary pads
Gift cards for food or SL public transport tickets
inte: Torn, dirty or worn-out clothes. Sorting them out costs time and money.
Furniture and large items without asking first.

tid.text: Most organisations welcome volunteers. The links go to their own pages.
